purpose: Code Intent workflow pinned tool versions for reproducible local setup.

external_required.name: Python
external_required.reason: MkDocs Material installation and PowerShell script support

external_required.name: Node.js
external_required.reason: future graph UI tooling and UnreelMCP bridge compatibility

notes: Installers are global/user-level and must not create node_modules, .venv, installers, or caches inside the repository.
winget --silent reduces prompts but Windows UAC can still require a manual Yes unless the shell already runs elevated.
LLVM is pinned to 20.1.8 because UnrealBuildTool warns that LLVM 22 is newer than the latest preferred version 20.1.8 and clang-uml 0.6.2 is built against LLVM 19.
